messages:
maria: kicking off account + VPC for az1-gpu-edge. need to finalize CIDR, subnet split, tags, and GPU quota requests. planning 4x A100 nodes for phase 1. also worried about egress/NAT cost in that region — throwing numbers here for discussion.

jon: proposed CIDR 10.64.0.0/16 to match regional pattern. public subnets /22, private /19. gives room for pods, stateful sets, and LB. objections?

raj: lgtm for CIDR. quick q — can we reuse central NAT GW in the shared infra account via peering/TC? saves cost but want to call out billing separation.

maria: we tested peering in eu-south last quarter, latency was fine. bigger snag is cost tagging: ops needs per-account tagging for chargeback.

ops-oncall: tagging policy reminder: tag_keys = [team, cost_center, env, project]. set cost_center=redwood-infra-gpu and env=prod. also confirm org SCPs allow nat creation in new account.

jon: for GPU quota request, file through support portal with payload below. include AZ, instance family, and exact count. paste to support ticket:

jon: ```json
{
  "region": "az1",
  "instanceTypes": ["a100","p4d"],
  "desired": 4,
  "reason": "prod cluster bootstrap for inference serving - reserved capacity phase 1"
}
```

quota-bot: Auto: Quota request received (ticket #45678). Typical SLA 24-72h. Will update here when approved.

maria: if NAT Gateway cost looks too high (we expect heavy egress during model warmup), fallback plan = NAT instance (auto-scale group + 2x EIP) inside account and route egress through it. cheaper but more ops.

raj: calling out tradeoffs: NAT instance reduces unit cost but increases patch surface and requires a healthcheck + replacement logic. prefer shared NAT if it stays within 30% of network budget.

maria: back-of-envelope: estimated egress 25 TB/month. AWS NAT GW pricing ~ $0.045/GB -> ~ $1,125/mo. NAT instance (2 c5.large + EIPs) ~= $300/mo + mgmt ops delta. still need load testing for throughput.

jon: bring-up checklist (short):
1) Create account & attach org SCPs
2) Run VPC scaffold TF module (CIDRs, subnets, route tables, flow logs)
3) KMS key + CMKs policy for S3 buckets (model weights)
4) Enforce tagging via org policy
5) Submit GPU quota ticket (include instance family + AZ spread)
6) Decide NAT path (shared vs instance) and update billing SR
7) Smoke deploy onto spot/dedicated nodes + perf run
8) Handoff to oncall with runbook link

maria: TF module link: github.com/redwood-infra/vpc-modules/aws/gpu-edge (use variable DEFAULT_NAT = "shared" | "instance"). Also enable flow logs and set retention to 90d.

maria: @ops-oncall can you take NAT decision + provisional cost approval? I can post perf numbers after a small egress stress test. :pray:

ops-oncall: I'll run quick cost calc and approve provisional NAT instance for the first 30 days while quota is pending. pinging finance for formal approval. :thumbsup:

finance-bot: FYI finance notified. Provisional approval granted for infra-gpu trial up to $1,500/mo while we validate traffic patterns. Please tag all resources with cost_center=redwood-infra-gpu.

maria: final notes: keep model weights in S3 with customer-managed KMS, enable object locking off, set lifecycle: warm->archive after 30d if not accessed, and enable flow logs. I'll update the runbook and post PR to docs.

jon: thanks — starting TF scaffold now and will post PR/plan here when ready.

raj: thanks team. I'll follow up on latency testing if we end up peering to shared NAT.
